# goldenpipe (TypeScript)

> Golden Suite orchestrator — chains GoldenCheck, GoldenFlow, and GoldenMatch into one adaptive pipeline. TypeScript port of the goldenpipe Python library.

## Install
```bash
npm install goldenpipe
```

## Authoritative sources
Read these instead of inferring behaviour from the compiled `dist/`:
- This file -- ships INSIDE the package: `node_modules/goldenpipe/llms.txt`.
- https://docs.bensevern.dev/goldenpipe -- full docs.
- https://github.com/benseverndev-oss/goldenmatch -- source + issues.
- Python sibling (the reference implementation): `pip install goldenpipe` -- same concepts, fuller surface.

## Notes

This is part of the Golden Suite. Suite-level index: https://docs.bensevern.dev/goldenpipe/llms.txt

Behaviour here is *decided* and contract-tested against the Python
implementation, not incidental. Reading `dist/` shows what one path does; it
does not show which guarantees are load-bearing, which fallbacks are
deliberate, or which knobs exist.
